```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release-cut:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install release-please

      - name: Create release candidate branch
        run: |
          git checkout -b release/candidate
          git push origin release/candidate

  release-please:
    needs: release-cut
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install release-please

      - name: Run release-please
        run: |
          npx release-please --repo-url=https://github.com/google/adk-python-community --release-type=python --changelog-path=CHANGELOG.md --candidate-pr-label=autorelease: pending --candidate-pr-title="chore(release): cut release candidate" --candidate-pr-body="This is an automatically generated pull request to cut a new release candidate."

  release-finalize:
    needs: [release-cut, release-please]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install release-please

      - name: Get release version
        id: get_version
        run: echo "::set-output name=version::$(git log --pretty=format:"%h" -n 1)"

      - name: Create final release branch
        run: |
          git checkout -b release/v${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}
          git push origin release/v${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}

      - name: Delete release candidate branch
        run: |
          git branch -D release/candidate
          git push origin --delete release/candidate

  release-publish:
    needs: release-finalize
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install setuptools wheel twine

      - name: Build package
        run: python setup.py sdist bdist_wheel

      - name: Publish to PyPI
        run: twine upload dist/*
        env:
          TWINE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.PYPI_USERNAME }}
          TWINE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PYPI_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Create merge-back PR
        run: |
          git checkout main
          git merge release/v${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          git push origin main
```
